$comment: Starter table of buff/debuff stacking rules for damage-rotation planning. Values are community-measured and may drift between patches.

entries.examples: Well of Radiance, Radiant, Noble Rounds, Empowering Rift
entries.stacking: Only the strongest empowering buff applies; they do not stack with each other.
entries.notes: Radiant and Well of Radiance share the same 25%/10% bucket in PvE.

entries.examples: Frenzy, Kill Clip, Vorpal Weapon, Bait and Switch
entries.stacking: Weapon perks stack multiplicatively with empowering buffs and global debuffs; most same-slot perks cannot be active together.
entries.notes: Two damage perks on one weapon (e.g. crafted enhanced combos) multiply.

entries.examples: Weaken, Tether, Divinity, Tractor Cannon, Felwinter's Helm
entries.stacking: Only the strongest debuff on a target applies; debuffs do not stack with each other.
entries.notes: Standard weaken is 15%, Tether/Tractor 30% in PvE.

entries.stacking: Up to 3 stacks: ~10%/17%/22% for matching damage type in PvE; stacks multiplicatively with buffs/debuffs.
entries.notes: Only affects weapons matching the surge element.

entries.stacking: Generally additive with surge mods within the same bucket; multiplicative with other buckets.
entries.notes: Check current artifact column for season-specific rules.
